definitions.explanation: The tall tower at an airport from which air traffic controllers direct the movement of aircraft on the ground and in the air.

examples.japanese: {管制塔|かんせいとう}から{指示|しじ}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: Instructions came from the control tower.

examples.japanese: パイロットは{管制塔|かんせいとう}と{交信|こうしん}している。
examples.english: The pilot is communicating with the control tower.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{管制塔|かんせいとう}が{完成|かんせい}し、{空港|くうこう}の{安全性|あんぜんせい}が{向上|こうじょう}した。
examples.english: The new control tower was completed, improving the airport's safety.

notes:
{管制塔|かんせいとう} is the tower at an airport where air traffic controllers direct aircraft movements.

WORD FORMATION:
{管制|かんせい} (control, regulation) + {塔|とう} (tower). {航空|こうくう}{管制|かんせい} (air traffic control) uses the same {管制|かんせい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {管制塔|かんせいとう}からの{指示|しじ}: instructions from the control tower
- {管制塔|かんせいとう}と{交信|こうしん}する: to communicate with the control tower
- {管制塔|かんせいとう}に{連絡|れんらく}する: to contact the control tower

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {管制官|かんせいかん}: air traffic controller
- {航空|こうくう}{管制|かんせい}: air traffic control
- {滑走路|かっそうろ}: runway
- {離着陸|りちゃくりく}: takeoff and landing

Also used figuratively to mean a central command point or headquarters directing operations.
